verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of roles, per-flag permissions, or scoped API tokens that limit who can change which flags. The only related item describes OAuth giving third-party apps scoped access instead of a personal key. That is an adjacent authorization feature, not flag-level access control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens
